name: smwmusic-sonic-mania-built-to-rule-titanic-monarch-zone-act
title: Sonic Mania - Built to Rule (Titanic Monarch Zone Act 1)
description:
An old port (~2018) that I decided to retouch (read: redo completely) and polish up for actual usage. Its intense atmosphere would be a great fit for final levels or other, very tense situations.

Included are an as-mixed version and an "smwvol" version, which is adjusted to take SMW's SFX volume in mind.
